# CGRX v0.1.0-alpha.12

This alpha reduces the context cost of agent-driven discovery and adds an opt-in semantic path for resolving concrete method dispatch without weakening coverage guarantees.

- Defaults managed MCP servers to token-efficient responses that return the compact model-visible projection once instead of duplicating the complete structured payload. The measured orient fixture falls from 41,684 bytes to 881 bytes, about 47 times smaller.
- Adds `--response-profile full` and `CGRX_RESPONSE_PROFILE=full` for clients that need complete `structuredContent` compatibility.
- Selects bounded orient presets from task intent so routine discovery starts with a smaller evidence budget and expands only when residual obligations require it.
- Aggregates repeated dynamic-dispatch uncertainty by path to keep coverage reports bounded while preserving every unresolved call site in the stored graph.
- Adds opt-in SCIP import through `cgrx index --scip <index.scip>` and `cgrx serve --scip <index.scip>`.
- Promotes a SCIP occurrence to a proof-bearing call edge only when the source revision, source text, exact call occurrence, and unique concrete target all agree.
- Keeps trait, abstract, protocol, method-specification, and pure-virtual targets as explicit dynamic-dispatch coverage gaps.
- Reimports managed SCIP data after source revision changes and includes the SCIP content identity in graph generation selection.

The downloadable Apple Silicon archive is accompanied by `SHA256SUMS`. Linux and Intel macOS remain pinned source-install paths with Rust 1.89.0.
